paragraphs.text: Live view of the agent's desktop in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, relayed from cua-spacesd behind DSH
's login, with take control and give back.
# dsh-desktop-view
Watch, live from the Web UI, the machine your DeepSeek Harness agent is running on: hear and see wha
t it does, and step in whenever assistance is required (a QR-code login, a CAPTCHA, an unexpected di
alog). While you hold control, two-way clipboard access plus file upload and download are available
hile you hold control, two-way clipboard access plus file upload and download are available as well.
The desktop stream that cua-spacesd (Cua's in-guest daemon) generates, together with Cua's web viewe
r, is carried over DSH's existing auth and web server. Nothing extra is exposed: no port or subdomai
n is opened, and no daemon credential ever reaches the browser.
## What you get
- **A Desktop tab on the right sidebar**, reachable either through the sidebar guide or via the moni

tor button in the session header.
- **A full-screen page** at `/desktop-view/`, served from your DSH
origin. It adapts to a phone screen, supports touch, and supports direct linking. Adding `?control=
1` makes it open directly in control mode, letting an agent that needs help send you a link; an agen
t asking for help sends `/desktop-view/?control=1&help=1&session=<its session id>`, so that giving c

ontrol back wakes it to carry on.
- **Watching is the default mode.** You see and hear the desktop,
while clicks, keystrokes, clipboard and files are refused. Picking "Take control" switches modes; "G
ive back" returns you to watching. Control likewise ends on its own after a stretch with no input, o
r when the view is closed. Merely hiding the Desktop tab (another sidebar tab, a collapsed sidebar,

another session) keeps your control; the stream pauses until you look again.
- **All the desktop vie
wer's features while you hold control**: mouse, keyboard and touch input, an on-screen keyboard, cli
pboard syncing, drag-and-drop file uploads, file browsing and downloads, display selection, scaling,

and the microphone wherever the desktop supports one.
- **The agent is kept informed.** For as long
as you hold control, a small JSON file is written by the plugin; the agent ought to read it before
acting on the desktop, and each control change notifies the session that opened the view.
## Requirements

- DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or later.
- `cua-spacesd` 0.12 or later on the same machine, with the DSH process a
ble to reach the env token (on Cua's desktop image that means `127.0.0.1:3211`, the token being at `

/run/cua/env-token`).
- An up-to-date browser: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari 17+. On mobile, both
Safari for iOS and Chrome for Android are supported.
## Installation
Directly from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Alternatively, add the bundle through the Web UI's plugin manager. Restart DSH afterwards.
## Configuration
Every option appears as a field in the `desktop-view` plugin row.
| Setting | Default | Description |
| `endpoint` | `http://127.0.0.1:3211` | Address on which cua-spacesd listens. Leave it on loopback,

as this address receives the env token. |
| `tokenFile` | `/run/cua/env-token` | File containing th

e env token; it stays on the server at all times. |
| `maxFps` | `30` | Frame rate requested by the

viewer. Reducing it lowers CPU and bandwidth use. |
| `clipboard` | `true` | Clipboard syncing while

you hold control. |
| `filesRoot` | `~` | Desktop folder you can browse, upload to and download fro

m while you hold control. Leaving it empty disables file transfer. |
| `microphone` | `true` | Permi

t sending your microphone to the desktop while you hold control, where the desktop supports it. |
|

`idleSeconds` | `120` | After this many seconds with no input, control reverts to watching. |
| `sta
teFile` | `/tmp/dsh-desktop-view/control.json` | Path at which the plugin writes the control state t

hat the agent reads. |
| `notifyAgent` | `wake` | Notify the session that opened the view whenever c
ontrol changes: `wake` (returning control wakes the agent if it is running or sent the help link; ot
herwise the note waits), `quiet` (notes always wait for the agent's next step), `off`. |
## What the agent can see
As an example, `stateFile` contains:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
When the owner holds control, `controller` is `"user"`; otherwise it is `null`. In the `null` case,
the file also records the most recent reason control ended (`lastReason`: `released`, `idle`, `disco
nnected`, `replaced`, `stopped`). Any script or skill that drives the desktop should check it first
and yield whenever the value is not `null`.
When `notifyAgent` is on, the session that opened a view gets a short note each time someone takes c
ontrol (queued; the agent is never woken for it) and each time control returns. The return note wake
s the agent only when it has to carry on: it is still running, or the view came from its help link (
`help=1`). Otherwise it waits quietly for the agent's next step, so no turn starts for nothing. In t
he chat the notes appear as a small "Desktop control" row.
## Security
- All requests aimed at the plugin's paths pass through DSH's admission checks: the Host/Origin fenc
e first, blocking cross-site and DNS-rebinding requests, then the browser's signed cookie, and no pr

incipal but the owner's is let in.
- The env token of cua-spacesd, along with the viewer tickets min
ted from it by the plugin, never leave the Host process. The browser keeps only short-lived relay ti
ckets, which function through this relay together with your DSH sign-in, and only for as long as the

view (and, for control, your control) persists.
- The server decides what the browser is allowed to
do. Watching uses a view-only viewer ticket, so input, clipboard and files are refused by the daemo
n itself; beyond that, only the media messages and calls that the viewer requires in each mode are f
orwarded by the relay. Only one view holds control at a time, and control ends once that view disapp

ears.
- The plugin's own pages go out with `no-store`, no referrer, and a content security policy th
at is strict and same-origin.
## Licensing
MIT. The desktop viewer displayed is Cua's web viewer, which your own cua-spacesd serves at runtime
under Cua's FSL-1.1-MIT licence; the plugin here is independent of Cua and neither includes nor redi
stributes that viewer.
